appraisal_events.evidence: Il me faut un « bon pour un baiser ». — Faut-il que je le signe ? ... Vous m'amusez avec vos bons, je vous en referai de temps en temps.
appraisal_events.explanation: Albertine takes teasing control of the pace of their intimacy, playfully offering and promising to renew tokens of future kisses, holding the leverage in the exchange while the narrator delights in her wit.

status_effects.explanation: Albertine gains a modest emotional advantage: she plays the one who bestows and renews favors, keeping the pacing of intimacy in her own hands while remaining warmly complicit.
